class.name: JRPGEventHost
class.brief_description: What events ask of the world beyond presenting things: moving the player, and later opening scenes.
class.description: Event commands that act on the world rather than on the game state alone go through an event host: [JRPGTransferPlayerCommand] moves the player with [method transfer_player] and waits while [method is_transferring]; the epics that build the menu, battles, saving, game over and the title screen add their scenes here. A single-player game's host is its scene manager's ([JRPGLocalHost]); online, the zone server's host acts on the world and tells the clients. The event runner gives its host to every interpreter ([method JRPGEventRunner.set_host]). This class does nothing by itself: a subclass, or a script overriding the virtual methods, carries the requests out. Authority: server.

method.name: _is_transferring
method.description: Returns whether a transfer is under way.

method.name: _transfer_player
method.description: Moves the player to [param cell] of map [param map_id] facing [param direction] through [param fade] ([enum Fade]); returns [constant OK] once the transfer started.

method.name: is_transferring
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a transfer is under way (its fade has not ended).

method.name: transfer_player
method.description: Moves the player to [param cell] of map [param map_id], facing [param direction] (0 to 3, or [constant DIRECTION_RETAIN]), through [param fade]. Returns [constant OK] once the transfer started (or happened, without a fade), an error with a warning when it is refused (a map the game lacks, a cell outside it, another transfer under way), or [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when the host cannot move the player.

constants.constant: The player keeps facing the way they face.
